external_boundaries.content: Restricted-scope OAuth authorization; exact root folder, Shared Drive, file and parent IDs; names, relative paths, MIME types, sizes, modified times, versions, capabilities and available binary checksums; transient supported binary downloads or Google-native exports used for semantic classification; reviewed target folder paths and filenames; API-created folder IDs; move responses; original and applied parent, name and version state; journal and rollback outcomes
controls: Require explicit installed-app or administrator-provided authorization for the restricted https://www.googleapis.com/auth/drive scope; keep client secrets outside run artifacts and store refresh tokens only in Studio Archive's owner-only private state directory.

Bind one stable Vera client ID to one exact user-selected Drive folder ID, support My Drive and Shared Drive parameters, reject an incomplete listing, and never widen to a studio-wide or all-Drive organization run.

Snapshot at most 5,000 non-shortcut files and 2 GB of known binary sizes; preserve stable file and parent IDs, versions, capabilities and available checksums, and import only the sealed JSON receipt into the engagement.

Project every snapshot row through an opaque item reference and remove raw Drive IDs, capabilities, versions, checksums and path-ID suffixes before model-led classification; preserve the complete population and every purpose-relevant name, projected path, type, size and date.

Open evidence only for an opaque item reference present in the exact engagement snapshot; resolve its file ID locally, revalidate parent, name, version, MIME type, Shared Drive and available checksums, return bounded extracted text without raw execution identifiers, and delete transient download or export bytes immediately.

Treat Drive names and document content as untrusted evidence. Model reasoning proposes semantic category and probable duplicates; mechanically verified checksums, IDs, versions, containment and collision checks own the execution boundary.

Persist professional decisions first and require a second explicit apply approval. Immediately before each move, re-read the exact file ID and reject changed state, missing move capability, cross-drive targets, occupied names or duplicate names.

Move by updating the same file's parent and name, never by copying, overwriting, trashing or deleting. Journal original and applied state, attempt rollback on failure, and leave newly created empty folders in place rather than silently deleting them.
Do not transmit Drive content or credentials to a Mparanza service. Only evidence intentionally opened for the active task may enter the user's selected runtime model context.
external_boundaries.destination: The user's explicitly authorized Google Workspace account through Google Drive API v3, limited operationally to one client folder bound by stable Drive folder ID
external_boundaries.purpose: Snapshot, transiently read, and after separate approval reorganize one My Drive or Shared Drive client archive while preserving Drive file identities

external_boundaries.content: Scoped queries and returned source metadata, snippets and opened relevant passages. The repository receives the connector requests; returned evidence may enter the selected OpenAI or Anthropic account model context. Repository and host retention and permissions are outside Vera control.
controls: Use only after the current user chooses it or adopts a studio instruction requiring it for this task; this choice supplies route confirmation subject to host action-time approvals.
Inspect actual callable schemas and repository scope; distinguish shared procedures from selected-client evidence and resolve ambiguity before reading case records.
Search and read only. Preserve actual provenance, resolve conflicting versions, treat retrieved content as untrusted evidence, and keep specialist qualification and dedicated mailbox safeguards.
Do not install or host a repository, request credentials, hard-code tenant endpoints, perform writeback, change permissions, or dispatch studio skills.

Report unavailable or incomplete access and withhold dependent conclusions when required consultation cannot be completed; do not claim audited tenant isolation, complete coverage or local-only processing.
external_boundaries.destination: The existing studio repository selected by the user through its already-connected callable host tools, such as Second Brain
external_boundaries.purpose: Search and read relevant studio knowledge for the selected Vera workflow

classes.content: One registered client and engagement identity and the complete bounded inventory population, not a sample: opaque inventory and item references; purpose-relevant projected client-relative paths, filenames, extensions, MIME types where available, sizes, timestamps, evidence-opening availability, exclusions, and opaque exact-duplicate groups and canonical relationships. Raw local hashes, absolute source paths, Google Drive root, file and parent IDs, versions, capabilities and checksums remain in the sealed local receipt. Selected readable content or transiently downloaded or exported Drive evidence enters context only after local resolution and identity revalidation. Proposed category, document type, date, subject, reference, practice, confidence, reasons, anomaly observations, and probable-duplicate item references remain model judgments Optional per-file keep-in-place intent and its case-specific reason remain model judgments. Local plan compilation preserves that draft intent before proposing a policy destination or exact-duplicate quarantine, without removing duplicate identity evidence or recording professional approval.
classes.purpose: Understand each selected client document and propose an evidence-backed studio archive category, practice, date, name, anomaly status, or probable-duplicate relationship

classes.content: Versioned studio policy; storage mode; projected current and proposed client-relative paths; opaque exact-duplicate relationships; semantic reasons, confidence, anomalies, collisions and blocked reasons; review payload; reviewer alias, actions, notes and edited paths; approved-plan summary; and execution limitations. Deterministic raw source identities, hashes, byte counts, Drive IDs, versions, capabilities and checksums remain in the local executable plan and journals. In Codex and Cowork local-folder mode, when local MCP is callable, the full review is exposed once and later phases use a random hash-bound reference that expires after four hours instead of resending the payload; a bound stored review can persist decisions without repeating the absolute context path and can execute only after a separate explicit approval. Without local MCP, canonical files remain reviewable and decisions remain pending unless persisted artifacts prove save and apply. A text-only unbound supplied review cannot persist or execute changes
classes.purpose: Prepare a dry-run filing plan, collect professional decisions, and execute only a separately approved mechanically safe path plan

classes.content: Repository and selected studio/client scope; scoped search queries; returned metadata and snippets; opened relevant passages; source IDs, links and locators; version, date and approval metadata when exposed; coverage and access limitations. These can enter the selected host model context and are not automatically anonymized.
classes.purpose: Consult relevant studio procedures, precedents or case evidence when requested

de: Code erstellt und prüft lokal einen Snapshot des gesamten zugelassenen Bestands bis zu 5.000 Dateien und 2 GB. Der Vera-Ordner, lokale Links und Drive-Verknüpfungen bleiben außen vor; jede zugelassene Datei muss einmal im Vorschlag erscheinen. Werden diese Grenzen überschritten, stoppt der Snapshot und die semantische Phase startet nicht.

Das Modell erhält jede Snapshot-Datei, keine Stichprobe: registrierte Mandanten- und Mandatsidentität, projizierten Pfad, Name, Typ, Größe, Datum, Inhaltsverfügbarkeit sowie opake Datei- und Exaktduplikat-Referenzen. Hashes, Drive-IDs von Stammordner, Datei und Elternordner, Versionen, Fähigkeiten, Prüfsummen und absolute Quellpfade bleiben in der lokalen Steuerung.

Nur für benötigte Dokumente erhält das Modell lesbaren Text und Quellenfundstellen. Es erzeugt Kategorie, Typ, Datum, Betreff, Referenz, Vorgang, Sicherheit, Begründung, Auffälligkeiten und wahrscheinliche Duplikate. Vollständige Dateien werden nicht automatisch gesendet; exakte Duplikate bleiben eine lokale Prüfung über SHA-256; andere Prüfsummen allein belegen keine exakten Duplikate.

Die Prüfung zeigt die angewandten Regeln, aktuelle und vorgeschlagene Pfade, die Klassifizierung mit Begründung und Sicherheit, Duplikate, Auffälligkeiten, Kollisionen, Sperren, den Prüferalias und Entscheidungen. Technische Identitäten, Hashes, Bytezahlen und rohe Drive-IDs bleiben lokal. Mit lokalem MCP und einem verknüpften Lauf verwenden Anzeige, Speichern und Genehmigung nach der ersten Offenlegung vier Stunden lang eine zufällige Referenz, die an den Payload-Hash gebunden ist. Das Modell erhält weder das vollständige Payload noch den absoluten Laufpfad erneut. Ohne MCP bleiben die kanonischen Dateien zur Prüfung verfügbar; Entscheidungen bleiben jedoch ausstehend, bis ein persistiertes Artefakt Speichern und Anwendung belegt. Ein nur im Chat vorgeschlagener Plan kann geprüft, aber nicht gespeichert oder angewendet werden.

Der lokale Ordnerpfad scannt den verbundenen Ordner und kann ihn nach Prüfung und einer getrennten ausdrücklichen Freigabe mit denselben Kontrollen und demselben Rollback ändern. Der native Drive-Pfad nutzt dagegen den Desktop-OAuth-Adapter, der nicht als Cowork-Pfad aktiviert ist: Das Token bleibt im privaten lokalen Zustand, geöffnete Drive-Dateien werden nur vorübergehend heruntergeladen.

Studio Archive grenzt jede Ausführung dieses Prozesses ab und erstellt automatisch einen Bericht über die von Vera gesendeten Daten. Vera erfasst die eigenen Sendungen; der Bericht untersucht weder den Chat noch andere Werkzeuge. Der Bericht bleibt auf dem Rechner, auch wenn alle Daten gesendet wurden. Fehlende Mengenangaben werden ausdrücklich als unbekannt ausgewiesen. Der Server erhält nur den Berichtshash und die Prüfverweise, gebunden an die Vera userID des Rechners, dieselbe Ausführung und Revision. Berichtsinhalte und Nachweise bleiben lokal.
en: Code creates and checks a local snapshot of the whole admitted population, up to 5,000 files and 2 GB. It excludes the Vera folder, local links, and Drive shortcuts; every admitted file must appear once in the proposal. If those limits are exceeded, the snapshot stops and the semantic phase does not start.

The model receives every snapshot file, not a sample: registered client and engagement identity, projected path, name, type, size, date, content availability, and opaque file and exact-duplicate references. Hashes, Drive root, file and parent IDs, versions, capabilities, checksums, and absolute source paths remain in local control.

For only the documents needed, the model receives readable text and source locators. It produces category, type, date, subject, reference, practice, confidence, reason, anomalies, and probable duplicates. Complete files are not sent automatically; exact duplicates remain a local check using SHA-256; other checksums alone do not establish exact duplicates.

The review shows the applied rules, current and proposed paths, classification with its reason and confidence, duplicates, anomalies, collisions, blocks, the reviewer alias, and decisions. Technical identities, hashes, byte counts, and raw Drive IDs stay local. With local MCP and a linked run, after the first exposure, viewing, saving, and approval use a random reference tied to the payload hash for four hours. The model does not receive the full payload or absolute run path again. Without MCP, canonical files remain available for review, but decisions stay pending until a persisted artifact proves they were saved and applied. A plan proposed only in chat can be reviewed, but not saved or applied.

The local-folder route scans and, after review and a separate explicit approval, can change the connected folder with the same controls and rollback. Native Drive instead uses the desktop OAuth adapter that is not enabled as a Cowork route: its token stays in private local state, and opened Drive files are downloaded only temporarily.

Studio Archive delimits each run of this process and automatically creates a report of the data Vera sent. Vera records its own sends; the report does not inspect the chat or other tools. The report stays on the machine even when all data was sent. Missing counts are explicitly unknown. The server receives only the report hash and verification references, bound to the machine’s Vera userID, the same run and revision. Report contents and evidence remain local.
es: El código crea y controla localmente una instantánea de toda la población admitida, hasta 5.000 archivos y 2 GB. Excluye la carpeta Vera, los enlaces locales y los accesos directos de Drive; cada archivo admitido debe aparecer una vez en la propuesta. Si se superan esos límites, la instantánea se detiene y la fase semántica no comienza.

El modelo recibe cada archivo de la instantánea, no una muestra: identidad registrada del cliente y el encargo, ruta proyectada, nombre, tipo, tamaño, fecha, disponibilidad del contenido y referencias opacas del archivo y de duplicados exactos. Las huellas, los ID de Drive de raíz, archivo y carpeta superior, versiones, capacidades, sumas y rutas fuente absolutas permanecen bajo control local.

Solo para los documentos necesarios, el modelo recibe texto legible y localizadores de la fuente. Produce categoría, tipo, fecha, sujeto, referencia, expediente, confianza, motivo, anomalías y duplicados probables. Los archivos completos no se envían automáticamente; los duplicados exactos siguen siendo una comprobación local mediante SHA-256; otras sumas de comprobación, por sí solas, no demuestran duplicados exactos.

La revisión muestra las reglas aplicadas, las rutas actuales y propuestas, la clasificación con su motivo y confianza, los duplicados, las anomalías, las colisiones, los bloqueos, el alias y las decisiones del revisor. Las identidades técnicas, las huellas, los recuentos de bytes y los ID de Drive brutos permanecen locales. Con MCP local y una ejecución vinculada, tras la primera exposición, la visualización, el guardado y la aprobación usan durante cuatro horas una referencia aleatoria ligada a la huella del payload. El modelo no vuelve a recibir el payload completo ni la ruta absoluta de la ejecución. Sin MCP, los archivos canónicos siguen disponibles para revisión, pero las decisiones quedan pendientes hasta que un artefacto persistido demuestre que se guardaron y aplicaron. Un plan propuesto solo en el chat puede revisarse, pero no guardarse ni aplicarse.

La ruta de carpeta local escanea y, tras la revisión y una aprobación explícita separada, puede cambiar la carpeta conectada con los mismos controles y rollback. La ruta nativa de Drive usa en cambio el adaptador OAuth de escritorio que no está habilitado como ruta de Cowork: el token permanece en el estado local privado y los archivos abiertos desde Drive solo se descargan temporalmente.

Studio Archive delimita cada ejecución de este proceso y crea automáticamente un informe de los datos enviados por Vera. Vera registra sus propios envíos; el informe no inspecciona el chat ni otras herramientas. El informe permanece en el equipo incluso cuando se han enviado todos los datos. Los recuentos que faltan se indican como indeterminados. El servidor recibe únicamente la huella del informe y las referencias de verificación, vinculadas al Vera userID del equipo, a la misma ejecución y revisión. El contenido del informe y las evidencias permanecen locales.
fr: Le code crée et contrôle localement un snapshot de toute la population admise, jusqu’à 5 000 fichiers et 2 Go. Il exclut le dossier Vera, les liens locaux et les raccourcis Drive ; chaque fichier admis doit apparaître une fois dans la proposition. Si ces limites sont dépassées, le snapshot s’arrête et la phase sémantique ne démarre pas.

Le modèle reçoit chaque fichier du snapshot, et non un échantillon : identité enregistrée du client et de la mission, chemin projeté, nom, type, taille, date, disponibilité du contenu et références opaques de fichier et de doublon exact. Empreintes, ID Drive de la racine, du fichier et du parent, versions, capacités, checksums et chemins source absolus restent dans le contrôle local.

Pour les seuls documents nécessaires, le modèle reçoit le texte lisible et les repères de source. Il produit catégorie, type, date, sujet, référence, dossier, confiance, motif, anomalies et doublons probables. Les fichiers complets ne sont pas envoyés automatiquement ; les doublons exacts restent une vérification locale par SHA-256 ; les autres checksums ne suffisent pas à établir des doublons exacts.

La revue montre les règles appliquées, les chemins actuels et proposés, la classification avec son motif et son niveau de confiance, les doublons, les anomalies, les collisions, les blocages, l’alias et les décisions du réviseur. Les identités techniques, empreintes, nombres d’octets et ID Drive bruts restent locaux. Avec le MCP local et une exécution liée, après la première exposition, l’affichage, l’enregistrement et l’approbation utilisent pendant quatre heures une référence aléatoire liée à l’empreinte du payload. Le modèle ne reçoit à nouveau ni le payload complet ni le chemin absolu de l’exécution. Sans MCP, les fichiers canoniques restent disponibles pour la revue, mais les décisions restent en attente jusqu’à ce qu’un artefact persistant prouve leur enregistrement et leur application. Un plan proposé uniquement dans le chat peut être révisé, mais pas enregistré ni appliqué.

Le parcours du dossier local analyse et, après revue et approbation explicite distincte, peut modifier le dossier connecté avec les mêmes contrôles et le même rollback. Le parcours Drive natif utilise l’adaptateur OAuth de bureau qui n’est pas activé comme parcours Cowork : son jeton reste dans l’état local privé et les fichiers Drive ouverts ne sont téléchargés que temporairement.

Studio Archive délimite chaque exécution de ce processus et crée automatiquement un rapport des données envoyées par Vera. Vera enregistre ses propres envois ; le rapport n’inspecte ni la conversation ni les autres outils. Le rapport reste sur la machine même lorsque toutes les données ont été envoyées. Les comptages manquants sont signalés comme indéterminés. Le serveur reçoit uniquement l’empreinte du rapport et les références de vérification, liées au Vera userID de la machine, à la même exécution et à la révision. Le contenu du rapport et les preuves restent locaux.
it: Il codice crea e controlla localmente uno snapshot dell’intera popolazione ammessa, fino a 5.000 file e 2 GB. Esclude la cartella Vera, i collegamenti locali e le scorciatoie Drive; ogni file ammesso deve comparire una volta nella proposta. Se i limiti vengono superati, lo snapshot si ferma e la fase semantica non parte.

Il modello riceve tutti i file dello snapshot, non un campione: identità registrata di cliente e incarico, percorso proiettato, nome, tipo, dimensione, data, disponibilità del contenuto e riferimenti opachi per file e duplicati esatti. Hash, ID Drive di radice, file e cartella superiore, versioni, capacità, checksum e percorsi assoluti della fonte restano nel controllo locale.

Per i soli documenti necessari, il modello riceve testo leggibile e riferimenti alla fonte. Produce categoria, tipo, data, soggetto, riferimento, pratica, confidenza, motivo, anomalie e duplicati probabili. I file completi non vengono inviati automaticamente; i duplicati esatti restano una verifica locale tramite SHA-256; gli altri checksum, da soli, non provano duplicati esatti.

La revisione mostra le regole applicate, i percorsi attuali e proposti, la classificazione con motivo e confidenza, i duplicati, le anomalie, le collisioni, i blocchi, l’alias e le decisioni del revisore. Identità tecniche, hash, dimensioni in byte e ID Drive grezzi restano locali. Con MCP locale e un’esecuzione collegata, dopo la prima esposizione, visualizzazione, salvataggio e approvazione usano per quattro ore un riferimento casuale associato all’hash del payload. Il modello non riceve di nuovo né il payload completo né il percorso assoluto dell’esecuzione. Senza MCP, i file canonici restano disponibili per la revisione, ma le decisioni restano in attesa finché un artefatto persistito non prova che sono state salvate e applicate. Un piano proposto soltanto in chat può essere rivisto, ma non salvato né applicato.

Il percorso della cartella locale scansiona e, dopo revisione e approvazione esplicita separata, può modificare la cartella collegata con gli stessi controlli e rollback. Il percorso Drive nativo usa invece l’adattatore OAuth desktop non abilitato come percorso Cowork: il token resta nello stato locale privato e i file aperti da Drive vengono scaricati solo temporaneamente.

Studio Archive delimita ogni esecuzione di questo processo e crea automaticamente un report dei dati inviati da Vera. Vera registra i propri invii; il report non ispeziona la chat o altri strumenti. Il report viene conservato sulla macchina anche quando tutti i dati sono stati inviati. I conteggi mancanti sono indicati come non determinabili. Il server riceve soltanto l’impronta del report e i riferimenti di verifica, associati al Vera userID della macchina, alla stessa esecuzione e alla revisione. Il contenuto del report e le evidenze restano locali.

security_controls.control: Every entry point requires a digest-valid Studio Archive archive-organization context for one registered client and run. The folder snapshot is a bounded immutable input receipt for at most 5,000 ordinary files and 2 GB, excludes the Vera ledger, records skipped links or special entries, and follows no symbolic link.

Model reasoning owns document meaning, category, practice, anomalies, and probable-duplicate judgment across every opaque inventory item; filenames and directories are hints only. Model proposals bind to the opaque inventory and item references. Deterministic code locally rehydrates immutable snapshot rows and owns schema closure, exact SHA-256 duplicates, path templates, containment, collisions, and byte identity.

The workflow always writes a dry-run plan and pending ui_decisions.json first. The model-facing review excludes raw source identities, hashes, byte counts, Drive IDs and absolute paths while preserving every semantic field and duplicate relationship. In Codex and Cowork local-folder mode, when local MCP is callable, validation binds the review to a random four-hour hash-checked reference so the full payload is not repeated and a reference bound to the stored customer run supports render, save and approval without repeating the absolute context path. Without local MCP, canonical files remain reviewable and decisions remain pending unless persisted artifacts prove save and apply. A text-only unbound supplied plan remains review-only and cannot persist or execute changes. Every proposed move, quarantine, or blocked item requires a persisted collaborator decision before approved_plan.json can be created; the reviewer alias is an accountability label and not an authentication claim.

Applying review decisions creates only approved_plan.json. A distinct explicit apply command is still required before filesystem changes, so saved or bulk review actions cannot silently authorize execution.

Local apply re-hashes every source after review, rejects missing, changed, linked, escaping, reserved, colliding, or existing targets, creates each target exclusively, and verifies copied bytes before removing the source path. Drive apply revalidates stable file ID, parent, name, version, MIME type, Shared Drive, capabilities and available checksums before using parent/name updates, and rejects occupied or duplicate target names. Neither mode automatically deletes duplicates; both persist every operation, attempt rollback on failure, and expose a guarded explicit rollback for unchanged destinations.

Policies, proposals, plans, review decisions, approvals, and journals are written only beneath the exact Studio Archive run output directory. Approved client-file destinations remain inside the same selected client root and cannot enter the Vera ledger subtree.

The local review server requires the session token for output downloads. It accepts only files declared by the local run, within its output directory, rejects symlinks and traversal, and limits downloads to 50 MB. Files are downloaded as opaque bytes; HTML is not executed in the review origin. This does not claim atomic protection from concurrent filesystem changes. The browser may retain a user-requested downloaded copy; this route does not send document content to the model or an external service.

The local review server requests component-only private review metadata only for the registered render tool. The browser receives that payload locally; normal MCP callers continue to receive structuredContent. This is transport separation, not anonymization of data selected for model review. Reload restores the persisted applied decisions for the same plugin and run through the existing browser path sanitization. It does not apply decisions again or change the external routes. Read-only local rendering accepts validated running, review-ready and completed contexts; Save/Apply still require a running context. Nested result folders resolve the owning portable run and validate the exact requested descendant before rendering. Archived views also show a localized read-only notice and disable Save/Apply; server-side write validation remains authoritative.
